court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Joint Civil Judge Senior Division, Gondia (Case No. not mentioned)
case_name: Smt. Baynabai W/O Balakdas Choure vs Balakdas S/O Prabhudas Choure

parties.respondent_defendant: Respondent-husband, a/a 48 yrs., Occ. - Tailor Shop Owner

facts_of_case: Marriage between the couple was solemnized on 2-5-1999. The petitioner suffered a paralytic attack in 2010 resulting in partial physical disablement.

legal_principles.principle: A spouse's income from a business can be considered while determining maintenance pendente lite.
legal_principles.held: The respondent though is suffering physical disability to the extent of 50%, his tailoring shop is still being operated with help of two labours and the major sons.

legal_principles.principle: A spouse's natural guardianship responsibilities can be considered while determining maintenance.
legal_principles.held: The wife being natural guardian of daughter Priyanka is required to look after basic needs of daughter Priyanka as well as her education expenses.

outcome.final_order: The trial court's order directing the petitioner to pay maintenance pendente lite at Rs. 2,500/- per month was set aside.
